recommendations.outsole_compound: Fast Shot outsole with high-abrasion rubber
recommendations.pros: Exceptionally lightweight, best-in-class breathability, and massive underfoot energy return. Smooth forward-rolling efficiency built specifically for elite marathon racing.
recommendations.cons: Glued-down non-removable insole and potential outsole durability issues for heavy heel strikers.

recommendations.pros: Exceptional energy return and an invisible on-foot feel. Highly rockered geometry maximizing propulsion across marathon distances.
recommendations.cons: Narrow toe box may cause discomfort and the heel pocket design can cause friction or blisters.

recommendations.pros: Incredibly bouncy ride with an extremely lightweight build. Spring-loaded feel that excels at high-speed efforts and tempo intervals.
recommendations.cons: Narrow heel and midfoot limit landing stability, and outsole durability is relatively low.

recommendations.outsole_compound: Continental rubber in forefoot & LightTraxion lateral rubber
recommendations.pros: Great step-in feel with durable performance lasting hundreds of miles. Carbon fiber EnergyRods offer snappy propulsion at a budget-friendly race price.
recommendations.cons: Laces can be frustratingly difficult to dial in and tie securely.

recommendations.pros: Versatile performance that bridges marathon training with race day speed. Outstanding outsole durability with a full carbon Flyplate propulsion.
recommendations.cons: Narrow fit with a restrictive toe box that may feel unstable on uneven road camber.

tips: Be sure to complete at least one marathon-pace long run in your chosen carbon-plated shoe to adapt to its aggressive rocker and stiff plate geometry.
Since racing super-shoes often feature snug upper profiles, test your race-day socks during training to avoid midfoot or heel blisters on race morning.
